messages.text: Heads up team: two dealers called me this morning about slow decisions on auto apps. One said they waited almost 4 hours on a prime-tier deal yesterday. Anyone seeing the same thing in the queue?

Yes, partly. LoanDesk was dragging on credit pulls Tuesday afternoon, CreditPull kept timing out and we had to re-run a bunch. Things look normal today, but the backlog from Tuesday pushed some into Wednesday.

Related: {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0008}} bought through one of those dealers and they're complaining the dealer told them funding would be same day. The loan on {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00015}} didn't book until Wednesday. Dealer is blaming us.
I can pull timestamps on the CreditPull retries if that helps. I'd rather show dealers actual turnaround numbers than just say 'we had an outage.'
Yes please, Richard. Break it out by dealer for the last 2 weeks, median time from submission to decision. I want to know if it's systemic or just Tuesday.
Fwiw one of my dealers also griped that stips requests come in piecemeal. They get 3 separate emails asking for docs instead of one list. That's on us, not the system.
Fair. I'll start sending one consolidated stip list per app. Kathleen, send me the dealer names that complained so I can prioritize their files this week.
I'll call {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0008}} back this afternoon and explain the booking timeline, and I'll loop in the dealer rep so everyone has the same story. Will post the outcome here.
